metadata.name: codex-ntfy-reply-listener-service
metadata.description: Install and validate the persistent Codex ntfy reply listener with local queue storage on a Gentoo/OpenRC host.

variables.name: repo_root
variables.description: Local checkout used to install the reply-listener service.

variables.name: ntfy_env_file
variables.description: Export file containing NTFY_URL and CODEX_NTFY_* variables.

variables.name: reply_queue_dir
variables.description: Directory containing pending and processed reply queue files.

stages.summary: Run the repo shell validation suite before changing host service state.
Install the OpenRC reply-listener service, enable it, and restart it.
Confirm the reply-listener OpenRC service is running.
artifacts: stdout or stderr includes status: started

stages.summary: Inspect the reply queue directories created for pending and processed messages.
